status: provisional standalone fixture guardrails; not runtime configuration or engine promises
scope: One serial synthetic roads/128-sample terrain fixture, unprofiled Python 3.12.14 on Ryzen 7 7700X / Windows 11; no game

memory.scope: Lifetime child-process peak including imports and fixture setup, GetProcessMemoryInfo; not VRAM

accounting_overhead.scope: Trivial-function wrapper microbenchmark, 4 fresh processes/mode, 20 batches of 100000 calls per mode

proposed_limits.derivation: Observed maxima times 1.25, rounded upward to simple guardrails. Proposed tolerances, not statistically established acceptance thresholds; no automatic tuning or runtime enforcement.

streaming_payload.scope: One fixture's serialized artifact payload only; excludes protocol/network framing. No engine throughput or production queue budget inferred.

engine_pending.reason: Other session protected; no unoccupied authorized engine session used

limitations: Prepared-cache cold only; OS page cache not purged
Protected other-session background load uncontrolled; only our own benchmarks serialized
Two cold and ten warm observations do not establish production tails
Pipeline accounting on/off runs establish output parity; they bypass wrapped worker jobs
Normalization overlaps source_fetch and process CPU includes all current-process threads; do not sum overlapping stage CPU
Warm cache is normalized MapData reuse, not persistent compiled artifacts or cross-run road plans
No game performance, global coverage, collision correctness or speedup claim
